axis: esm2_t33_650M_depth1_go_terms: depth-1-only GO-term prediction, WITHOUT aspect input to the classifier (baseline half of the aspect-conditioning ablation, see trial-078)
note: New track per user direction: before fully committing to the sequential-cascade prospect, test how well a 650M full fine-tune does on the much smaller (39-term) depth-1-only GO-term label space (kelmoir/cafa6-depth1, generate_dataset_depth1.py) - and, in trial-078, how much a ground-truth aspect input helps that same task. This trial (trial-077) is the baseline: exactly trial-075's hyperparameters (unfreeze_last_n=27, lr=2e-5, weight_decay=0.2, output_dropout=0.2, bf16, --no-gradient-checkpointing, checkpoint-mode every-epoch, 8 epochs, 6000 train (resampled)/1000 val, seed=42), fresh start from facebook/esm2_t33_650M_UR50D (not resumed from trial-075/076's checkpoint - those were fine-tuned for a completely different 383-term label space and classifier head shape, no principled reason to carry that over). --batch-size 16 first OOM'd consistently despite the LengthGroupedSampler fix (a different memory source than the batch-composition/padding issue that fix targeted - not yet root-caused) -> switched to --batch-size 8 --grad-accum-steps 2 (effective batch size 16, matching trial-075/076's optimizer-step granularity) per user direction, now the standing default for this model class going forward: trial-076 already showed batch=8/accum=2 costs no real wall-clock penalty (272-296s/epoch, matching batch=16's own 276-296s/epoch). Only two things differ from trial-075 besides the batch/accum change: --dataset-repo-id kelmoir/cafa6-depth1 (39 depth-1 terms instead of 383 coarse terms) and --use-aspect-input is NOT set here (trial-078 sets it). Model architecture is otherwise identical to trial-075's plain EsmForSequenceClassification/EsmClassificationHead. --push-to-hub deliberately NOT set - this is a first exploratory trial in a brand new direction, not yet a promotion candidate; pushes only to its own kelmoir/cafa6-esm@trial-077 branch via --checkpoint-mode every-epoch. --run-diagnostic is auto-appended by build_notebook.py.
